description: Weak: very short, telegraphic answers, almost no connected sentences, and near-constant basic errors (wrong/missing verb, wrong gender, no connectors). Reconstructed to match the pre-change experiment's case 1 description and marks (verification-log.md, 2026-09-27 Part 2) — exact original wording was not logged. Iterated three times: v1 and v2 (Comm 7-8/QoL 7, both fully error-ridden but still structurally complete sentences) stayed just inside Table C's 7-9 'frequent errors' band; removing almost all sentence structure (isolated words/short fragments, no subordination, no connectors) in this v3 dropped it into the 1-3 'almost always inaccurate' band and cleared both gates 3/3 (Comm 4-5/15, QoL 1/15).
